name: The Rolling Stones

whyMatters.en: London blues-rock band, formed in 1962. From early blues and R&B covers they built a Jagger–Richards writing system, and by the late 1960s–early 1970s a mature album and live style.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦蓝调摇滚乐队，1962 年成立。从早期蓝调和 R&B 翻唱开始，逐渐形成 Jagger–Richards 的写作体系，并在 1960 年代末至 1970 年代初建立起成熟的专辑和现场风格。

note.en: Early Decca single; Chuck Berry cover.
note.zh: 早期 Decca 单曲；Chuck Berry 翻唱。

note.en: Written by Lennon–McCartney for the Stones.
note.zh: 由 Lennon–McCartney 为 Stones 所写。

note.en: Richards fuzz riff (Gibson Maestro FZ-1); US and UK #1.
note.zh: Richards fuzz riff（Gibson Maestro FZ-1）；英美榜冠军。

note.en: Hard-rock single ahead of Beggars Banquet.
Let It Bleed; Merry Clayton guest vocal.
note.zh: 出自《Let It Bleed》；客串人声 Merry Clayton。
出自《Some Girls》的美国榜冠军。

note.en: Built around a fuzz-treated guitar riff. US and UK #1 in 1965. The same year Out of Our Heads was their first US album #1.
note.zh: 以 fuzz 处理的吉他 riff 为核心。1965 年登上英美单曲榜冠军。同年《Out of Our Heads》成为首张美专辑榜冠军。

note.en: From Beggars Banquet; samba-style percussion and call-and-response vocals. Followed Their Satanic Majesties Request (1967), which tried a Sgt. Pepper–adjacent psychedelic approach.
note.zh: 出自《Beggars Banquet》；桑巴式打击乐与呼应人声。前一张《Their Satanic Majesties Request》（1967）曾尝试贴近《Sgt. Pepper》的迷幻做法。

note.en: Opening track on Let It Bleed (1969). Richards’s guitar riff leads; Merry Clayton on guest vocal; Watts and Wyman on the rhythm section. Mick Taylor was already on guitar after Jones.
note.zh: 《Let It Bleed》（1969）开场曲。Richards 的吉他 riff 构成基础；Merry Clayton 加入人声；Watts 与 Wyman 负责节奏。Jones 之后吉他已由 Mick Taylor 担任。

shortBio.en: London blues-rock band, formed in 1962. Early work rested on American blues and R&B covers; then a Jagger–Richards writing system. Brian Jones, Mick Taylor, and Ronnie Wood mark successive guitar lineups.
shortBio.zh: 伦敦蓝调摇滚乐队，1962 年成立。早期以美国蓝调和 R&B 翻唱为基础，随后形成 Jagger–Richards 的主要写作体系。Brian Jones、Mick Taylor 和 Ronnie Wood 分别代表了不同阶段的吉他编制。

body.en: London blues-rock band, formed in 1962. Early work rested on American blues and R&B covers; then a Jagger–Richards writing system. Brian Jones, Mick Taylor, and Ronnie Wood mark successive guitar lineups.
body.zh: 伦敦蓝调摇滚乐队，1962 年成立。早期以美国蓝调和 R&B 翻唱为基础，随后形成 Jagger–Richards 的主要写作体系。Brian Jones、Mick Taylor 和 Ronnie Wood 分别代表了不同阶段的吉他编制。

body.en:
Many Stones songs start from a guitar riff, then drums, bass, and vocal build the groove.

Keith Richards’s rhythm guitar and open-G tuning stand out in the mid-period work. Charlie Watts kept a steady drum feel with jazz influence. As members changed, the second guitar, bass, and keys roles shifted, but the Jagger–Richards–Watts core lasted a long time.
body.zh:
Stones 的很多歌曲都从一个吉他 riff 开始，再由鼓、贝斯和人声建立 groove。

Keith Richards 的节奏吉他和开放 G 调在中期作品中尤其突出。Charlie Watts 则维持稳定、带有爵士乐影响的鼓点。随着成员变化，第二吉他、贝斯和键盘的位置不断调整，但 Jagger、Richards 和 Watts 构成的核心持续了很长时间。

alt.en: The Rolling Stones in a 1965 Billboard trade ad (London Records)
alt.zh: The Rolling Stones 1965 年 Billboard 广告照（London Records）

title.zh: 组建、Avory 与 Decca 单曲

body.en:
When Jagger, Richards, and Brian Jones formed the early band, the lineup also included bassist Dick Taylor and pianist Ian Stewart.

Taylor later left and formed The Pretty Things. Mick Avory rehearsed with them and, with Tony Chapman, played the 12 July 1962 debut gig, then left; he later became The Kinks’ drummer.

After Charlie Watts and Bill Wyman joined, the early classic rhythm section was in place.

Before the first album, the Stones had already issued Come On, I Wanna Be Your Man, and Not Fade Away. Ian Stewart later focused on tour management and studio piano.
body.zh:
Jagger、Richards 和 Brian Jones 组建早期乐队时，成员还包括贝斯手 Dick Taylor 和钢琴手 Ian Stewart。

Taylor 后来离队并组建 The Pretty Things。Mick Avory 参与过排练，并与 Tony Chapman 参加 1962 年 7 月 12 日的首演，随后离开，后来成为 The Kinks 的鼓手。

Charlie Watts 和 Bill Wyman 加入后，形成了早期经典节奏组。

在首张专辑之前，Stones 已发行《Come On》《I Wanna Be Your Man》和《Not Fade Away》等单曲。Ian Stewart 后来主要负责巡演管理和录音室钢琴。

alt.en: The Rolling Stones arrive at Fornebu Airport, Oslo, June 1965
alt.zh: The Rolling Stones 抵达奥斯陆 Fornebu 机场，1965 年 6 月

title.en: Shared facts with Beatles and Kinks
title.zh: 与 Beatles、Kinks 的交叉事实

body.en:
I Wanna Be Your Man was written by Lennon–McCartney for the Stones and was an important single before the first album.

Mick Avory briefly played with the early Stones, then spent years as The Kinks’ drummer.

Their Satanic Majesties Request (1967) clearly used then-fashionable psychedelic studio methods; Beggars Banquet afterward returned to more direct blues-rock.
body.zh:
《I Wanna Be Your Man》由 Lennon–McCartney 写给 Stones，是乐队首张专辑之前的重要单曲。

Mick Avory 短暂参与 Stones 的早期演出后，长期担任 The Kinks 鼓手。

1967 年的《Their Satanic Majesties Request》明显采用了当时流行的迷幻录音方式；之后的《Beggars Banquet》则重新回到更直接的蓝调摇滚。

body.en:
Brian Jones played many instruments on early- and mid-1960s recordings. After his death in 1969, Mick Taylor joined.

Taylor took part in major sessions and live work after Let It Bleed, including Sticky Fingers, Exile on Main St., and Get Yer Ya-Ya’s Out!. He left in 1975.

Harvey Mandel and Wayne Perkins appeared on Black and Blue sessions before Ronnie Wood joined as a long-term member. Charlie Watts remained drummer until 2021.
body.zh:
Brian Jones 在 1960 年代早中期的录音中承担了大量不同乐器的演奏。1969 年去世后，Mick Taylor 加入乐队。

Taylor 参与了《Let It Bleed》之后的重要录音和现场演出，包括《Sticky Fingers》《Exile on Main St.》以及《Get Yer Ya-Ya’s Out!》。他于 1975 年离队。

Harvey Mandel 和 Wayne Perkins 曾参与《Black and Blue》的录音，最终由 Ronnie Wood 加入并成为长期成员。Charlie Watts 则一直担任鼓手至 2021 年。

alt.en: Keith Richards, Bill Wyman, and Charlie Watts at Turku Airport, 25 June 1965
alt.zh: Keith Richards、Bill Wyman 与 Charlie Watts 在图尔库机场，1965 年 6 月 25 日

body.en:
Satisfaction was released in 1965.

Its clearest sound is Keith Richards’s fuzz guitar riff, run through a Gibson Maestro FZ-1. Jagger’s vocal circles the repeated lyric.

The single then hit #1 in the US and UK. The same year, Out of Our Heads became the Stones’ first US album-chart #1.
body.zh:
《Satisfaction》于 1965 年发行。

歌曲最突出的声音来自 Keith Richards 的 fuzz 吉他 riff，使用 Gibson Maestro FZ-1 处理。Jagger 的人声围绕反复出现的歌词展开。

单曲随后登上英美榜冠军。同年，《Out of Our Heads》成为 Stones 第一张登上美国专辑榜冠军的专辑。

body.en:
Gimme Shelter opens Let It Bleed (1969).

Richards’s guitar riff is the song’s base; Merry Clayton adds vocals; Charlie Watts and Bill Wyman hold the rhythm. Brian Jones was no longer the main guitarist; Mick Taylor took part in related sessions.

The song still sits on blues-rock, with more layers from voice, guitar, and dynamics.
body.zh:
《Gimme Shelter》是《Let It Bleed》（1969）的开场曲。

Richards 的吉他 riff 构成歌曲基础，Merry Clayton 加入人声，Charlie Watts 和 Bill Wyman 负责节奏部分。Brian Jones 此时已不再是主要吉他手，Mick Taylor 参与了相关录音。

歌曲仍以蓝调摇滚为基础，但通过人声、吉他和动态变化形成更大的层次。

title.zh: 从 Sticky Fingers 到体育场巡演

body.en:
After Sticky Fingers (1971), the Stones issued a run of US album-chart #1 records.

Exile on Main St. (1972) is usually treated as a key studio album of the period. Goats Head Soup and It’s Only Rock ’n Roll followed, including Angie.

Some Girls (1978) and Tattoo You (1981) line up with later large-scale live work. Bill Wyman left in 1993; Darryl Jones then took bass.
body.zh:
《Sticky Fingers》（1971）之后，Stones 连续推出多张美国专辑榜冠军作品。

《Exile on Main St.》（1972）通常被视为这一时期的重要录音室作品。之后还有《Goats Head Soup》和《It’s Only Rock ’n Roll》，其中包括《Angie》等代表歌曲。

1978 年的《Some Girls》和 1981 年的《Tattoo You》则对应了乐队后来的大型现场演出阶段。1993 年 Bill Wyman 离队，Darryl Jones 随后担任贝斯手。

title.en: Jagger, Richards, and the rhythm section

body.en:
Jagger and Richards long wrote and produced together as the Glimmer Twins.

Richards’s open tunings and rhythm guitar are a large part of the Stones sound. Watts’s drumming stayed relatively restrained, with a clear jazz background.

As members changed, second guitar and bass roles kept shifting. Billy Preston, Nicky Hopkins, Chuck Leavell and others appeared on sessions and tours at different stages.
body.zh:
Jagger 和 Richards 长期以 Glimmer Twins 的名义共同制作和创作。

Richards 的开放调弦和节奏吉他，是 Stones 声音的重要组成部分。Watts 的鼓点则保持相对克制，带有明显的爵士乐背景。

随着成员变化，第二吉他和贝斯的角色不断调整。Billy Preston、Nicky Hopkins、Chuck Leavell 等音乐人也参与过不同阶段的录音和巡演。

body.en:
Blues-based riff writing, open tunings, and Jagger’s vocal approach kept feeding later hard rock, garage rock, and some indie bands.

Albums from 1968–72 especially concentrate that writing and arranging. Long touring also kept those songs in the live set for decades.
body.zh:
Stones 以蓝调为基础的 riff 写作、开放调弦和 Jagger 的演唱方式，对后来的 hard rock、车库摇滚以及部分 indie 乐队都有持续影响。

1968–72 年间的几张专辑尤其集中体现了这种写作和编曲方式。与此同时，长期巡演让这些歌曲成为乐队现场曲目中持续存在的一部分。

note.en: Taylor left and formed The Pretty Things. Avory rehearsed and played the July 1962 debut, then left for The Kinks. Stewart stayed off the official stage lineup.
note.zh: Taylor 离队组建 The Pretty Things。Avory 参与排练与 1962 年 7 月首演后离开，后入 The Kinks。Stewart 未进入正式舞台编制。

note.en: From Decca singles through Beggars Banquet and Let It Bleed. Jones died in 1969.
note.zh: 从 Decca 单曲到《Beggars Banquet》与《Let It Bleed》。Jones 于 1969 年去世。

note.en: From Let It Bleed through It’s Only Rock ’n Roll; Sticky Fingers and Exile on Main St. fall in this window.
note.zh: 从《Let It Bleed》到《It’s Only Rock ’n Roll》；含《Sticky Fingers》与《Exile on Main St.》。

note.en: Wood from 1975. Wyman left in 1993; Darryl Jones on bass thereafter. Watts died in 2021.
note.zh: Wood 自 1975 年起。Wyman 于 1993 年离队，此后贝斯为 Darryl Jones。Watts 于 2021 年去世。

note.en: Built around a fuzz-treated guitar riff. Reached #1 on the US and UK singles charts in 1965.
note.zh: 以 fuzz 处理的吉他 riff 为核心。1965 年登上英美单曲榜冠军。

note.en: Blues-based riff, rhythm, and vocal approach that later fed into hard rock and other guitar-driven rock.
note.zh: 以蓝调为基础的 riff、节奏和演唱方式，后来成为 hard rock 以及其他吉他摇滚的重要组成部分。
